title: The Open Corridor
voiceProvenance: AI synthesized English / Seed-TTS 2.0; original fictional dialogue

narrative.text: 今夜，所有公共屏幕都显示着同一幅画面：一个银色光点，无声地越过外层警戒线。
narrative.english: Tonight, every public screen carries the same picture: a silver point, crossing the outer watch line without a sound.

captions.text: 今夜，所有公共屏幕都显示着同一幅画面：一个银色光点，无声地越过外层警戒线。
captions.english: Tonight, every public screen carries the same picture: a silver point, crossing the outer watch line without a sound.

narrative.text: 市场把它称作机遇，各部称它为事件；在夜半球观看的孩子们，把它叫作星星。
narrative.english: The markets have named it an opportunity. The ministries call it an incident. Children watching from the night side call it a star.

captions.text: 市场把它称作机遇，各部称它为事件；在夜半球观看的孩子们，把它叫作星星。
captions.english: The markets have named it an opportunity. The ministries call it an incident. Children watching from the night side call it a star.

narrative.text: 我们已学会在行星之间建造城市，却仍向陌生者提出最古老的问题：你能给我们什么？
narrative.english: We have learned to build cities between planets, and still we ask a stranger the oldest question: what can you give us?

captions.text: 我们已学会在行星之间建造城市，却仍向陌生者提出最古老的问题：你能给我们什么？
captions.english: We have learned to build cities between planets, and still we ask a stranger the oldest question: what can you give us?

narrative.text: 民用频道，这里是接触管制。你们的画面存在延迟。请提醒观众：目标尚未回应我们。
narrative.english: Civil network, this is contact control. Your picture is delayed. Please remind your audience that the object has not acknowledged us.

captions.text: 民用频道，这里是接触管制。你们的画面存在延迟。请提醒观众：目标尚未回应我们。
captions.english: Civil network, this is contact control. Your picture is delayed. Please remind your audience that the object has not acknowledged us.

narrative.text: 人们把那片沉默解释成自己需要的模样：承诺、威胁，或是对手犯错的证明。
narrative.english: That silence has become whatever people need it to be. A promise, a threat, a proof that their rivals were wrong.

captions.text: 人们把那片沉默解释成自己需要的模样：承诺、威胁，或是对手犯错的证明。
captions.english: That silence has become whatever people need it to be. A promise, a threat, a proof that their rivals were wrong.

narrative.text: 记录在案：沉默只是沉默。我们没有尾气光谱、可辨识标记，也没有内部结构测量。
narrative.english: For the record, silence is only silence. We have no exhaust spectrum, no readable markings, and no measurement of its interior.

captions.text: 记录在案：沉默只是沉默。我们没有尾气光谱、可辨识标记，也没有内部结构测量。
captions.english: For the record, silence is only silence. We have no exhaust spectrum, no readable markings, and no measurement of its interior.

narrative.text: 议会已表决同意接待代表团。但截至目前，没有任何证据表明代表团正在到来。
narrative.english: The assembly has voted to receive a delegation. There is, as yet, no evidence that a delegation is coming.

captions.text: 议会已表决同意接待代表团。但截至目前，没有任何证据表明代表团正在到来。
captions.english: The assembly has voted to receive a delegation. There is, as yet, no evidence that a delegation is coming.

narrative.text: 我们的船员并不决定新闻标题。他们接受训练，为的是守住一条通道。他们会履行职责。
narrative.english: Our crews did not choose the headlines. They trained to keep a corridor open, and that is what they will do.

captions.text: 我们的船员并不决定新闻标题。他们接受训练，为的是守住一条通道。他们会履行职责。
captions.english: Our crews did not choose the headlines. They trained to keep a corridor open, and that is what they will do.

narrative.text: 两千艘舰船正守着那条通道。每台明亮引擎后，都有一个原本打算下班回家的人。
narrative.english: Two thousand hulls are holding that corridor. Behind each bright engine is a person who expected to come home after this shift.

captions.text: 两千艘舰船正守着那条通道。每台明亮引擎后，都有一个原本打算下班回家的人。
captions.english: Two thousand hulls are holding that corridor. Behind each bright engine is a person who expected to come home after this shift.

narrative.text: 公共转播转接舰队接近频道。紧急频段保持畅通。接触目标仍在向内飞行。
narrative.english: Transferring the public relay to the fleet approach channel. We are keeping the emergency band clear. Contact continues inbound.

captions.text: 公共转播转接舰队接近频道。紧急频段保持畅通。接触目标仍在向内飞行。
captions.english: Transferring the public relay to the fleet approach channel. We are keeping the emergency band clear. Contact continues inbound.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 不明飞行器，这里是边界舰队。你正在进入受控航道。请减速并报告出发地点。
narrative.english: Unidentified craft, this is the boundary fleet. You are entering a controlled transit lane. Reduce speed and identify your point of origin.

captions.text: 不明飞行器，这里是边界舰队。你正在进入受控航道。请减速并报告出发地点。
captions.english: Unidentified craft, this is the boundary fleet. You are entering a controlled transit lane. Reduce speed and identify your point of origin.

narrative.text: 保持阵型，留出接近走廊。任何舰长都不得把明亮反光误判为武器发射。
narrative.english: Hold formation. Keep the approach corridor open. No captain is to mistake a bright reflection for a weapon discharge.

captions.text: 保持阵型，留出接近走廊。任何舰长都不得把明亮反光误判为武器发射。
captions.english: Hold formation. Keep the approach corridor open. No captain is to mistake a bright reflection for a weapon discharge.

narrative.text: 我们可以提供导航参照与安全停泊点。请在本载波回应，或改变航向以确认收到信息。
narrative.english: We can provide navigation references and a protected holding position. Acknowledge on this carrier, or change your course to confirm reception.

captions.text: 我们可以提供导航参照与安全停泊点。请在本载波回应，或改变航向以确认收到信息。
captions.english: We can provide navigation references and a protected holding position. Acknowledge on this carrier, or change your course to confirm reception.

narrative.text: 它的轨迹异常干净。测距脉冲的回波中，没有接缝、天线或外露机械通常产生的散射。
narrative.english: Its track is exceptionally clean. Our ranging pulses return without the scattering we expect from seams, antennae, or exposed machinery.

captions.text: 它的轨迹异常干净。测距脉冲的回波中，没有接缝、天线或外露机械通常产生的散射。
captions.english: Its track is exceptionally clean. Our ranging pulses return without the scattering we expect from seams, antennae, or exposed machinery.

narrative.text: 仍无回应。我已用接触协议、数学编码和简单导航灯序列发送邀请。
narrative.english: Still no reply. I have repeated the invitation in the contact protocol, mathematics, and a plain sequence of navigation lights.

captions.text: 仍无回应。我已用接触协议、数学编码和简单导航灯序列发送邀请。
captions.english: Still no reply. I have repeated the invitation in the contact protocol, mathematics, and a plain sequence of navigation lights.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 那就发送条件：停在内侧警戒线外，关闭武器系统，接受远程检查。不会有登舰队靠近。
narrative.english: Then transmit the terms. Stop outside the inner line, power down any weapon system, and accept remote inspection. No boarding party will approach.

captions.text: 那就发送条件：停在内侧警戒线外，关闭武器系统，接受远程检查。不会有登舰队靠近。
captions.english: Then transmit the terms. Stop outside the inner line, power down any weapon system, and accept remote inspection. No boarding party will approach.

narrative.text: “投降”一词已在公共信息流中传播。舰队司令部发出了指令，来客却没有作出任何承诺。
narrative.english: The word surrender is already spreading through the public feeds. Fleet command has issued instructions; the visitor has made no agreement.

captions.text: “投降”一词已在公共信息流中传播。舰队司令部发出了指令，来客却没有作出任何承诺。
captions.english: The word surrender is already spreading through the public feeds. Fleet command has issued instructions; the visitor has made no agreement.

narrative.text: 指挥官，仪器甚至无法确认它是否有可关闭的动力系统。我们描述的是自己的舰船，未必是它。
narrative.english: Commander, our instruments cannot establish that it has a power system to shut down. We are describing our ships, not necessarily theirs.

captions.text: 指挥官，仪器甚至无法确认它是否有可关闭的动力系统。我们描述的是自己的舰船，未必是它。
captions.english: Commander, our instruments cannot establish that it has a power system to shut down. We are describing our ships, not necessarily theirs.

narrative.text: 明白，继续记录。只要它能接收部分信息，就会知道这里提供了安全停下的方式。
narrative.english: Understood. Keep recording. If it can receive any part of our message, it will know there is a safe way to stop.

captions.text: 明白，继续记录。只要它能接收部分信息，就会知道这里提供了安全停下的方式。
captions.english: Understood. Keep recording. If it can receive any part of our message, it will know there is a safe way to stop.

narrative.text: 那个光点开始显出轮廓：圆头、细尾，没有可见姿态喷口。接近速度没有改变。
narrative.english: The point is becoming a shape now. Rounded nose, narrow tail. No visible attitude jets. Approach speed has not changed.

captions.text: 那个光点开始显出轮廓：圆头、细尾，没有可见姿态喷口。接近速度没有改变。
captions.english: The point is becoming a shape now. Rounded nose, narrow tail. No visible attitude jets. Approach speed has not changed.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 我需要武器操作员听清楚：光滑表面不是损伤评估，小小的轮廓也不代表强度低。
narrative.english: I need the weapons crews to hear this. A polished surface is not a damage assessment, and a small silhouette is not a measure of strength.

captions.text: 我需要武器操作员听清楚：光滑表面不是损伤评估，小小的轮廓也不代表强度低。
captions.english: I need the weapons crews to hear this. A polished surface is not a damage assessment, and a small silhouette is not a measure of strength.

narrative.text: 我们以交叉火力覆盖走廊，但没有封死通道。目标无法同时威胁所有舰体，这是当前判断。
narrative.english: We have crossed weapons to cover the corridor without closing it. The object cannot threaten every hull at once. That is our working assumption.

captions.text: 我们以交叉火力覆盖走廊，但没有封死通道。目标无法同时威胁所有舰体，这是当前判断。
captions.english: We have crossed weapons to cover the corridor without closing it. The object cannot threaten every hull at once. That is our working assumption.

narrative.text: 那就请把它明确标为假设。测距脉冲照射后，它的表面温度几乎未变。我们不知道能量去了哪里。
narrative.english: Then mark that sentence as an assumption. Its surface temperature has barely changed under our ranging pulses. We do not know where the energy goes.

captions.text: 那就请把它明确标为假设。测距脉冲照射后，它的表面温度几乎未变。我们不知道能量去了哪里。
captions.english: Then mark that sentence as an assumption. Its surface temperature has barely changed under our ranging pulses. We do not know where the energy goes.

narrative.text: 科学频道请求增大舰间距；指挥频道要求缩紧射击解算。两条指令都在等待确认。
narrative.english: Science channel is requesting wider separation between ships. Command channel is requesting a tighter firing solution. Both orders are waiting for confirmation.

captions.text: 科学频道请求增大舰间距；指挥频道要求缩紧射击解算。两条指令都在等待确认。
captions.english: Science channel is requesting wider separation between ships. Command channel is requesting a tighter firing solution. Both orders are waiting for confirmation.

narrative.text: 暂时保持间距。突然后撤可能被理解为开火准备。我不能因为屏幕上的一个符号而发动战争。
narrative.english: Maintain spacing for now. A sudden withdrawal could look like preparation to fire. I will not start a war by moving a symbol on a display.

captions.text: 暂时保持间距。突然后撤可能被理解为开火准备。我不能因为屏幕上的一个符号而发动战争。
captions.english: Maintain spacing for now. A sudden withdrawal could look like preparation to fire. I will not start a war by moving a symbol on a display.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 我也不会因为符号排列整齐，就说阵型安全。请在事发前，给外层各列分配独立撤离方向。
narrative.english: And I will not call a formation safe because its symbols are tidy. Give the outer ranks independent escape vectors before anything happens.

captions.text: 我也不会因为符号排列整齐，就说阵型安全。请在事发前，给外层各列分配独立撤离方向。
captions.english: And I will not call a formation safe because its symbols are tidy. Give the outer ranks independent escape vectors before anything happens.

narrative.text: 批准。载入撤离路线，受威胁前保持位置。受损舰优先使用救援频道，撤离路线避开射界。
narrative.english: Approved. Load evacuation routes, but hold your position until threatened. Damaged ships get priority on rescue traffic. Keep those routes out of the firing lanes.

captions.text: 批准。载入撤离路线，受威胁前保持位置。受损舰优先使用救援频道，撤离路线避开射界。
captions.english: Approved. Load evacuation routes, but hold your position until threatened. Damaged ships get priority on rescue traffic. Keep those routes out of the firing lanes.

narrative.text: 路线已分发。各舰长确认本地控制与独立引擎可用。即使阵型解体，紧急频道仍将识别每艘舰。
narrative.english: Routes distributed. Captains confirm local control and independent engines. The emergency channel will identify each hull, even if the formation breaks apart.

captions.text: 路线已分发。各舰长确认本地控制与独立引擎可用。即使阵型解体，紧急频道仍将识别每艘舰。
captions.english: Routes distributed. Captains confirm local control and independent engines. The emergency channel will identify each hull, even if the formation breaks apart.

narrative.text: 致家中的听众：分歧并不等于恐慌。画面清晰而解释不足时，谨慎的人就应当讨论。
narrative.english: For those listening at home, disagreement is not panic. It is what careful people do when the picture is clearer than the explanation.

captions.text: 致家中的听众：分歧并不等于恐慌。画面清晰而解释不足时，谨慎的人就应当讨论。
captions.english: For those listening at home, disagreement is not panic. It is what careful people do when the picture is clearer than the explanation.

narrative.text: 最后一条建议：一旦看到光束折返，立即避开其路径。不要假定反射光会沿原路回到发射源。
narrative.english: One last recommendation: if you see a beam return, clear its path immediately. Do not assume the return will follow the line back to its source.

captions.text: 最后一条建议：一旦看到光束折返，立即避开其路径。不要假定反射光会沿原路回到发射源。
captions.english: One last recommendation: if you see a beam return, clear its path immediately. Do not assume the return will follow the line back to its source.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 不明飞行器，这是最后警告。你即将接近内侧安全线。立即改变航向；你前方的通道仍然开放。
narrative.english: Unidentified craft, this is your final warning. You are approaching the inner safety line. Alter course now. We are leaving the corridor ahead of you open.

captions.text: 不明飞行器，这是最后警告。你即将接近内侧安全线。立即改变航向；你前方的通道仍然开放。
captions.english: Unidentified craft, this is your final warning. You are approaching the inner safety line. Alter course now. We are leaving the corridor ahead of you open.

narrative.text: 所有炮组，仅跟踪。启动光束前确认目标后方的舰体。屏幕里的背景，是另一群船员。
narrative.english: All batteries, track only. Confirm the hull behind your target before enabling a beam. The background on your screen is another crew.

captions.text: 所有炮组，仅跟踪。启动光束前确认目标后方的舰体。屏幕里的背景，是另一群船员。
captions.english: All batteries, track only. Confirm the hull behind your target before enabling a beam. The background on your screen is another crew.

narrative.text: 最新回波显示连续表面：无开口、无接缝，也无明显散热。请让每台传感器持续记录首次接触。
narrative.english: The latest return resolves a continuous surface. No opening, no joint, no obvious heat rejection. Please keep every sensor recording through first contact.

captions.text: 最新回波显示连续表面：无开口、无接缝，也无明显散热。请让每台传感器持续记录首次接触。
captions.english: The latest return resolves a continuous surface. No opening, no joint, no obvious heat rejection. Please keep every sensor recording through first contact.

narrative.text: 没有确认。载波强度稳定。这并非连接丢失，只是在我们理解的频率上，始终无人回应。
narrative.english: No acknowledgement. Carrier level is steady. This is not a lost connection; there is simply nobody answering on the frequencies we understand.

captions.text: 没有确认。载波强度稳定。这并非连接丢失，只是在我们理解的频率上，始终无人回应。
captions.english: No acknowledgement. Carrier level is steady. This is not a lost connection; there is simply nobody answering on the frequencies we understand.

narrative.text: 如果目标越线，最近的炮组可以短促射击。出现反射立即停火，不能追着错误的射线继续打。
narrative.english: If the object crosses the line, the nearest batteries may fire controlled bursts. Break off if the beam is reflected. Do not chase a bad shot.

captions.text: 如果目标越线，最近的炮组可以短促射击。出现反射立即停火，不能追着错误的射线继续打。
captions.english: If the object crosses the line, the nearest batteries may fire controlled bursts. Break off if the beam is reflected. Do not chase a bad shot.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

narrative.text: 舰体若被贯穿，立即隔离反应堆并保持距离。安静的残舰仍可能在倒计时。救援组必须等待安全接近。
narrative.english: If a hull is pierced, isolate its reactor and keep clear. A quiet wreck can still be counting down. Rescue crews must wait for a safe approach.

captions.text: 舰体若被贯穿，立即隔离反应堆并保持距离。安静的残舰仍可能在倒计时。救援组必须等待安全接近。
captions.english: If a hull is pierced, isolate its reactor and keep clear. A quiet wreck can still be counting down. Rescue crews must wait for a safe approach.

narrative.text: 只要接触管制还能维持转播，民用频道就会保持开放。今夜，不会有提前写好的胜利公告。
narrative.english: The civilian relay will remain open as long as contact control can carry it. There will be no victory announcement written in advance tonight.

captions.text: 只要接触管制还能维持转播，民用频道就会保持开放。今夜，不会有提前写好的胜利公告。
captions.english: The civilian relay will remain open as long as contact control can carry it. There will be no victory announcement written in advance tonight.

narrative.text: 确认越过内侧警戒线。两千个识别信号，各自独立。紧急频段已开放。各舰长，请用本舰呼号回应。
narrative.english: Inner line crossing confirmed. I have two thousand identification signals, all distinct. Emergency band is live. Captains, answer with your own hull call sign.

captions.text: 确认越过内侧警戒线。两千个识别信号，各自独立。紧急频段已开放。各舰长，请用本舰呼号回应。
captions.english: Inner line crossing confirmed. I have two thousand identification signals, all distinct. Emergency band is live. Captains, answer with your own hull call sign.

narrative.text: 允许在指定射界内开火。保持撤离路线畅通。邻舰中弹时先移动，能够通信后再报告。
narrative.english: Weapons free within your assigned lanes. Keep your escape route clear. If your neighbor is hit, move first and report when you can.

captions.text: 允许在指定射界内开火。保持撤离路线畅通。邻舰中弹时先移动，能够通信后再报告。
captions.english: Weapons free within your assigned lanes. Keep your escape route clear. If your neighbor is hit, move first and report when you can.

narrative.text: 它仍在前进。看接触点，不要被眩光迷惑。无论接下来发生什么，都要相信测量。所有岗位，保护好你们的人。
narrative.english: It is still coming. Watch the contact point, not the glare. Whatever happens next, trust the measurements. All stations, protect your people.

captions.text: 它仍在前进。看接触点，不要被眩光迷惑。无论接下来发生什么，都要相信测量。所有岗位，保护好你们的人。
captions.english: It is still coming. Watch the contact point, not the glare. Whatever happens next, trust the measurements. All stations, protect your people.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 温度没有升高。这一击毫无作用。
combat.english: No thermal rise. That shot did nothing.

captions.text: 温度没有升高。这一击毫无作用。
captions.english: No thermal rise. That shot did nothing.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 停止无效射击，检查反射路径。
combat.english: Cease wasteful fire. Check the return path.

captions.text: 停止无效射击，检查反射路径。
captions.english: Cease wasteful fire. Check the return path.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 表面完好，找不到任何痕迹。
combat.english: Surface intact. I cannot find a mark.

captions.text: 表面完好，找不到任何痕迹。
captions.english: Surface intact. I cannot find a mark.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 各炮组，光束正在散入我方航道。
combat.english: All batteries, your beams are scattering across our lanes.

captions.text: 各炮组，光束正在散入我方航道。
captions.english: All batteries, your beams are scattering across our lanes.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 反射光束！立即让开那条线！
combat.english: Reflected beam! Clear that line now!

captions.text: 反射光束！立即让开那条线！
captions.english: Reflected beam! Clear that line now!

combat.text: 角度变了，反射束正在横穿阵型！
combat.english: The angle changed. The return is crossing the formation!

captions.text: 角度变了，反射束正在横穿阵型！
captions.english: The angle changed. The return is crossing the formation!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 停火！反射方向后方有友舰！
combat.english: Hold fire! Friendly hull behind the reflection!

captions.text: 停火！反射方向后方有友舰！
captions.english: Hold fire! Friendly hull behind the reflection!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 确认接触。能量离开了表面，并未进入。
combat.english: Contact confirmed. Energy is leaving the surface, not entering it.

captions.text: 确认接触。能量离开了表面，并未进入。
captions.english: Contact confirmed. Energy is leaving the surface, not entering it.

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 两侧贯穿。正在隔离反应堆！
combat.english: Breach through both sides. Isolating the reactor!

captions.text: 两侧贯穿。正在隔离反应堆！
captions.english: Breach through both sides. Isolating the reactor!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 中央甲板全面失压！
combat.english: We have lost pressure across the central decks!

captions.text: 中央甲板全面失压！
captions.english: We have lost pressure across the central decks!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 它直接穿过了我们，关闭全部内部舱门！
combat.english: It went straight through us. Close every internal door!

captions.text: 它直接穿过了我们，关闭全部内部舱门！
captions.english: It went straight through us. Close every internal door!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 舰体被贯穿，导航失效，我们正在漂移！
combat.english: Hull pierced. Navigation is gone. We are drifting!

captions.text: 舰体被贯穿，导航失效，我们正在漂移！
captions.english: Hull pierced. Navigation is gone. We are drifting!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 约束正在失效，所有人远离核心！
combat.english: Containment is failing. Everyone away from the core!

captions.text: 约束正在失效，所有人远离核心！
captions.english: Containment is failing. Everyone away from the core!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 停堆没有生效，反应堆温度仍在上升！
combat.english: The shutdown did not take. Reactor temperature is still climbing!

captions.text: 停堆没有生效，反应堆温度仍在上升！
captions.english: The shutdown did not take. Reactor temperature is still climbing!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 反应堆警报！救援舰不要靠近我们！
combat.english: Reactor warning. Do not bring a rescue ship alongside us!

captions.text: 反应堆警报！救援舰不要靠近我们！
captions.english: Reactor warning. Do not bring a rescue ship alongside us!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 冷却已经耗尽，再也无法重启了！
combat.english: We are out of cooling. There is no restart from this!

captions.text: 冷却已经耗尽，再也无法重启了！
captions.english: We are out of cooling. There is no restart from this!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 求救！前舱仍有幸存者，有人能听到吗？
combat.english: Mayday. We have survivors in the forward section. Can anyone hear us?

captions.text: 求救！前舱仍有幸存者，有人能听到吗？
captions.english: Mayday. We have survivors in the forward section. Can anyone hear us?

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 救援频道，我们的机库封死了，需要外部接应！
combat.english: Rescue channel, our launch bay is sealed. We need an external pickup!

captions.text: 救援频道，我们的机库封死了，需要外部接应！
captions.english: Rescue channel, our launch bay is sealed. We need an external pickup!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 正在帮他们穿上宇航服，请保持监听。
combat.english: We are getting them into suits. Please keep a receiver on us.

captions.text: 正在帮他们穿上宇航服，请保持监听。
captions.english: We are getting them into suits. Please keep a receiver on us.

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 紧急信标已启动，漂移无法控制，请回应！
combat.english: Emergency beacon active. We cannot control our drift. Please respond!

captions.text: 紧急信标已启动，漂移无法控制，请回应！
captions.english: Emergency beacon active. We cannot control our drift. Please respond!

captions.text: 退后！
captions.english: Get back!

combat.text: 那艘舰消失了。救援艇远离残骸。
combat.english: We lost that hull. Rescue craft, stand clear of the debris.

captions.text: 那艘舰消失了。救援艇远离残骸。
captions.english: We lost that hull. Rescue craft, stand clear of the debris.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 确认爆炸，为幸存者让出通道。
combat.english: Explosion confirmed. Open a lane for the survivors.

captions.text: 确认爆炸，为幸存者让出通道。
captions.english: Explosion confirmed. Open a lane for the survivors.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 出现次级闪光，警惕附近再次失稳。
combat.english: Secondary flash. Watch for another reactor failure nearby.

captions.text: 出现次级闪光，警惕附近再次失稳。
captions.english: Secondary flash. Watch for another reactor failure nearby.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 他们的信号断了，正在标记最后位置。
combat.english: Their signal is gone. I am marking the last known position.

captions.text: 他们的信号断了，正在标记最后位置。
captions.english: Their signal is gone. I am marking the last known position.

captions.text: 收到，正在检查面板。
captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 脱离阵型，沿分配的撤离方向加速！
combat.english: Break formation. Accelerate along your assigned escape vector!

captions.text: 脱离阵型，沿分配的撤离方向加速！
captions.english: Break formation. Accelerate along your assigned escape vector!

captions.text: 这边！跟紧！
captions.english: This way! Keep together!

combat.text: 确认本地撤退，避开受损舰。
combat.english: Local retreat confirmed. Keep clear of the damaged ships.

captions.text: 确认本地撤退，避开受损舰。
captions.english: Local retreat confirmed. Keep clear of the damaged ships.

captions.text: 这边！跟紧！
captions.english: This way! Keep together!

combat.text: 别再等待全舰队，现在就移动本舰！
combat.english: Do not wait for the whole fleet. Move your own ship now!

captions.text: 别再等待全舰队，现在就移动本舰！
captions.english: Do not wait for the whole fleet. Move your own ship now!

captions.text: 这边！跟紧！
captions.english: This way! Keep together!

combat.text: 引擎有响应，我们正在拉开距离。

captions.text: 引擎有响应，我们正在拉开距离。
captions.english: Engines responding. We are opening the distance.

captions.text: 这边！跟紧！
captions.english: This way! Keep together!

combat.text: 一艘舰已离开战斗边界，信标仍然工作。
combat.english: One hull has cleared the combat boundary. Beacon still active.

captions.text: 一艘舰已离开战斗边界，信标仍然工作。

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 确认逃脱，继续前往集结区域。
combat.english: Escape confirmed. Keep moving until you reach the assembly area.

captions.text: 确认逃脱，继续前往集结区域。
captions.english: Escape confirmed. Keep moving until you reach the assembly area.

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 那群船员已经离开交战区，正在发送新坐标。

captions.text: 那群船员已经离开交战区，正在发送新坐标。

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.english: Their drive signature is stable beyond the perimeter.

captions.text: 边界外，他们的推进信号已经稳定。
captions.english: Their drive signature is stable beyond the perimeter.

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

captions.text: 通信被切断，切换下一个有效信标。

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 那艘舰的载波消失了，保持紧急频段畅通。
combat.english: No carrier from that ship. Keep the emergency band clear.

captions.text: 那艘舰的载波消失了，保持紧急频段畅通。
captions.english: No carrier from that ship. Keep the emergency band clear.

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

combat.text: 我们听到了求救，标记位置，继续撤离。

captions.text: 我们听到了求救，标记位置，继续撤离。

captions.english: Aye, checking the panel.

captions.text: 闪光时遥测也停止了，没有后续读数。

captions.text: 航向已保持。炮组待命。
captions.english: Course held. Batteries standing by.

extra.text: 控制台下面起火了！正在切断电源！

extra.english: All hands, abandon the bridge! Move!

captions.english: All hands, abandon the bridge! Move!

captions.text: 舱门卡住了！
captions.english: The hatch is jammed!

captions.text: 走后方通道！不要停！
captions.english: Use the aft passage! Keep moving!

extra.english: Use the aft passage! Keep moving!

captions.text: 反应堆破损！快离开！
